claims.statement: Airtable user API keys were the former API credential; their deprecation period ended on 1 February 2024 and they can no longer access the Airtable API.

sources.supports: On Jan 18, 2023, we began the deprecating user API keys, completing the deprecation process on Feb 1, 2024, meaning: API Keys can no longer access the Airtable API.
sources.locator: FAQs: How do I find my API key?

sources.supports: As of February 1st 2024, the deprecation period for Airtable API keys has ended.
Updated [Authentication](/api/authentication) to reflect that the deprecation period for Airtable API keys has ended.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: The format of the legacy API key is not stated on the pages read, and the pages read do not give a durable pin for historical claims; the candidate is not researched beyond existence and its deprecated status. Lead only: one scanner rule artifact by a single maintainer (gitleaks rule "airtable-api-key" in config/gitleaks.toml @ b58d3f102cf3a2c84cb7f923d05c25c9b1aed84b, L112-L116) uses a 17-alphanumeric pattern; a single artifact does not meet the tool-corroborated requirement, so no format claim is recorded.
